summary:
Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the repository, without running tests or committing.

Changes:
- monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs; coordinates are [start, stop] per dimension, including the channel row, in the unpadded frame. Docstring updated with a Yields section and a Note on the format. set_rnd skips attribute names starting with "__".
- monai/data/grid_dataset.py: new PatchIter (builds the patch size with a None channel entry, normalizes start_pos with ensure_tuple, delegates to iter_patch with copy_back=False). GridPatchDataset rewritten with dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; worker split uses numpy ceil; transform applied per patch via apply_transform(map_items=False); raises NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement len().") when len() fails. math import removed; PatchDataset docstring uses float instead of np.float.
- monai/data/__init__.py: exports PatchIter.
- docs/source/data.rst: PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset.
- tests/test_grid_dataset.py: new, class TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_len.

Choices to review:
- Missing-length message read as "image dataset must implement len()." (period outside the code span).
- set_determinism(seed=1234) is called in setUp only; the test body does not call it again.
- Coordinates are int64 arrays.

Not verified: tests were not run, so the pinned RandShiftIntensity values are checked only by reasoning against arange(16) images. Nothing committed.
